title: Remove Element
summary: Move all values other than val into the beginning of nums and return their count k.
statement: Move all values other than val into the beginning of nums and return their count k. Any order is valid in the first k positions, and the suffix is ignored.
hints: Conceptual: The unused suffix has no constraints.
Directional: Keep a write position for retained values.
Implementation: Scan once, copying a value to the write position only when it differs from val.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
